  -- Observation: Confirmed that the Dastardly Mash headstone image shows a Crème Brulee headstone in the background. Read the rhyme on the Crème Brulee headstone.
  -- Thought: Validated that the background headstone in the Dastardly Mash photo is indeed Crème Brulee and extracted the last line of its rhyme.
  -- Result: Confirmed the last line is "So it may not be beaucoup too late to save Crème Brulee from beyond the grave."
